newsitem.title: USA: ZOLL Medical to take Q1 $2.3 mln charge.
newsitem.headline: ZOLL Medical to take Q1 $2.3 mln charge.

text.p: ZOLL Medical Corp said on Monday it would take a $2.3 million one-time charge in the first quarter for legal and acquisition costs.
The company said the charge was related to its recent acquisition of assets from Wastech Information Systems and the anticipated expenses to defend the existing shareholder litigation.
About $1.3 million of the charge is related to the cost of proceeding to trial in a class action shareholder suit initiated in 1994, the company said.

Until recently, Zoll believed the unsubstantiated claims of the plaintiffs would allow it to settle the lawsuit without litigation. But the company said it had been unable to reach a reasonable settlement with plaintiffs' attorney in spite of its best efforts.
ZOLL said it believed it had meritorious defenses and would prevail in trial.
